text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Pendaftaran Ahli Farmasi

(Pindaan Jadual Pertama) 2024.

Pindaan Jadual Pertama

2. Akta Pendaftaran Ahli Farmasi 1951 dipinda dalam Jadual Pertama,

berhubung dengan negara "Malaysia", dengan menggantikan butiran "KPJ Healthcare

University College" dengan butiran "KPJ Healthcare University (formerly known as

KPJ Healthcare University College)".

Dibuat 22 Januari 2024

[KKM.600-18/2/94; PN(PU2)200/V]

DATUK SERI DR. HAJI DZULKEFLY BIN AHMAD

Menteri Kesihatan

REGISTRATION OF PHARMACISTS ACT 1951

REGISTRATION OF PHARMACISTS (AMENDMENT OF FIRST SCHEDULE) ORDER 2024

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 6(3) of the

Registration of Pharmacists Act 1951 [Act 371], the Minister, after consulting the Board,

makes the following order:
